1	#Requires -Version 5.1
2	<#
3	.SYNOPSIS
4	    Prune merged git branches across many repositories — locally and/or on GitHub.
5	
6	.DESCRIPTION
7	    Two independent modes, selected with -Local and/or -Remote (pass both for "both"):
8	
9	      -Local   Scans configured root folder(s) for git clones, runs `git fetch --prune`,
10	               and flags local branches that are either:
11	                 * gone   — their upstream tracking branch was deleted on the server
12	                            (catches squash-merged PRs that `git branch --merged` misses)
13	                 * merged — fully merged into the repo's default branch
14	               Uses your cached git credentials only to fetch. Deletes local branches only.
15	
16	      -Remote  Not filesystem based. Asks GitHub for *your merged PRs* in the configured
17	               org(s) — i.e. "every repo you've contributed to" — and offers to delete the
18	               head branches that still exist on the server. Uses your `gh` keyring auth.
19	
20	    Each candidate is tagged so you can see WHY it was flagged.
21	
22	    Safety: protected branches (main/master/develop/...), the repo default branch, and the
23	    currently checked-out branch are never offered. Local branches that are gone-but-not-merged
24	    require -Force (a `git branch -D`). Nothing is deleted without confirmation unless -Yes.
25	
26	.PARAMETER Local
27	    Prune local merged branches in your cloned repositories.
28	
29	.PARAMETER Remote
30	    Prune remote branches of your merged GitHub PRs. Pass with -Local for both.
31	
32	.PARAMETER Init
33	    Interactively create/update the config file (scan roots + GitHub orgs), then exit.
34	
35	.PARAMETER DryRun
36	    List what would be deleted and stop. Deletes nothing.
37	
38	.PARAMETER DeleteAll
39	    Skip the interactive selection and target every flagged branch.
40	
41	.PARAMETER Yes
42	    Skip the final "are you sure?" confirmation.
43	
44	.PARAMETER Force
45	    Also delete local branches that are gone-upstream but NOT merged into the default branch
46	    (these would otherwise be skipped because they may contain unpushed work).
47	
48	.PARAMETER NoFetch
49	    Skip `git fetch --prune` in local mode (faster / offline; "gone" detection may be stale).
50	
51	.PARAMETER Org
52	    Override the GitHub org(s) for remote mode (defaults to config).
53	
54	.PARAMETER Root
55	    Override the local scan root folder(s) for this run (defaults to config).
56	
57	.PARAMETER RepoFilter
58	    Only consider repositories whose name matches this wildcard (e.g. 'hubix-*').
59	
60	.PARAMETER ConfigPath
61	    Path to the config file (default: %USERPROFILE%\.branch-pruner\config.json).
62	
63	.PARAMETER MaxDepth
64	    How deep to search for repos under each local root (default 6).
65	
66	.EXAMPLE
67	    .\prune-branches.ps1 -Init
68	    First-time setup: choose scan roots and GitHub orgs.
69

73

76	    Preview the server-side branches of your merged PRs without deleting.
77
